verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say users can "easily forward physical items wherever you need them" from the virtual mailbox, which points to self-serve forwarding rather than emailing support, but that single marketing line is the only evidence for this story. Check-to-bank forwarding is a separate, adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, one-click forwarding flow, saved recipients/address book, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, independent or hands-on corroboration.
